get.summary:
List records with optional field-level filtering. Filter values use bracket-prefixed operator syntax.
            
Operators: [eq] (exact match), [contains] (case-insensitive substring, strings only),
[gt], [lt], [ge], [le] (comparisons, numbers only).
            
Bare values (no operator) use a default: [contains] for text fields, [eq] for IDs/numbers/booleans.
            
Combine filters: different properties are ANDed. Repeated keys are ANDed (e.g. amount=[gt]1000&amount=[lt]5000).
Multiple operator-value pairs in one key are ORed (e.g. name=[contains]Cash[contains]Bank).
            
Invalid syntax returns 400 — bad filters never silently return unfiltered results.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: The project (collection) ID.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Query string filter parameters. Each property on the filter corresponds to a filterable field.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Optional. Only return records modified after this timestamp.

parameters.name: tns-continuation-token
parameters.description: Pagination token from a previous response. Pass to retrieve the next page.

parameters.name: includeDeprecatedItems
parameters.description: Include archived/deprecated records. Defaults to false.

post.summary:
Trial balance by account. Returns one row per account with unadjusted balance,
adjustment total, and adjusted balance for each requested period.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: The project (collection) ID.

requestBody.description: Period IDs (required), plus optional entity, interim period, and adjustment type filters.

post.summary:
Trial balance by account group. Returns one row per account group with amounts
summed across all accounts in each group, for each requested period.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: The project (collection) ID.

requestBody.description: Period IDs (required), plus optional entity, interim period, and adjustment type filters.

post.summary:
Trial balance by financial statement group. Returns one row per financial statement type
(Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, Expense) with amounts summed across all account groups
of that type, for each requested period.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: The project (collection) ID.

requestBody.description: Period IDs (required), plus optional entity, interim period, and adjustment type filters.

post.summary:
Adjustments by adjustment header. Returns each adjustment with its line items pre-joined,
including resolved account name and number on each line item.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: The project (collection) ID.

requestBody.description: Period IDs (required), plus optional interim period and adjustment type filters.

post.summary:
Adjustment totals by account. Returns one row per impacted account with the sum of
adjustment line item amounts and count of distinct adjustments, for each requested period.
Only accounts with adjustment activity are included.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: The project (collection) ID.

requestBody.description: Period IDs (required), plus optional entity, interim period, and adjustment type filters.

post.summary:
Adjustment totals by account group. Returns one row per impacted account group with
summed adjustment amounts and distinct adjustment counts, for each requested period.
Only account groups with adjustment activity are included.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: The project (collection) ID.

requestBody.description: Period IDs (required), plus optional entity, interim period, and adjustment type filters.

post.summary:
Adjustment totals by financial statement group. Returns one row per impacted financial
statement type (Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, Expense) with summed adjustment amounts
and distinct adjustment counts, for each requested period.
Only financial statement types with adjustment activity are included.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: The project (collection) ID.

requestBody.description: Period IDs (required), plus optional entity, interim period, and adjustment type filters.

post.summary:
Consolidated trial balance by account group. Returns one row per account group with
totals summed across all included entities, plus a per-entity breakdown showing each
entity's contribution to the row totals.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: The project (collection) ID.

requestBody.description: Period IDs (required). EntityIds optional (omit to consolidate all). Plus optional interim period and adjustment type filters.

post.summary:
Consolidated trial balance by financial statement group. Returns one row per financial
statement type (Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, Expense) with totals summed across
all included entities, plus a per-entity breakdown.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: The project (collection) ID.

adjustmentStatus.description: Reserved for future use. Not currently applied as a filter.

periodIds.description: One or more period IDs to include. Required.

entityIds.description: Optional. Scope results to specific entities. If omitted, all entities are included.

interimPeriodId.description: Optional. Filter unadjusted balances and adjustments to a specific interim period.

adjustmentTypeIds.description: Optional. Explicit list of adjustment type IDs to include. If omitted, all types except "passed" are included.

adjustmentTypeIds.description: Optional. Explicit list of adjustment type IDs to include. If omitted, all types except "passed" are included.
